**Last Republican gubernatorial win in New York**

- **Year:** 1994  
- **Governor elected:** George Pataki (served 1995‑2007)

**Ballot lines that appeared on the 1994 ballot for George Pataki**

| Ballot line | Party name |
|-------------|------------|
| Republican | Republican Party of New York |
| Conservative | Conservative Party of New York |
| Tax Cut Now | Tax‑Cut‑Now Party |

*Sources*

1. New York State Board of Elections, “1994 Nov 8 • General • Governor” – the candidate list shows **George Pataki & Betsy McCaughey** under the three lines *Republican / Conservative / Tax Cut Now*【5†L14-L18】.  
2. The same results page lists the lines in the “Candidates” section, confirming the three parties【5†L41-L45】.

Thus, when George Pataki was first elected as governor in 1994, the ballot listed him under the **Republican, Conservative, and Tax Cut Now parties**.
